author: JivisDerian
quote: Despite its impressive visuals and ambitious world, GTA VI suffers from noticeable technical issues, including bugs, inconsistent animations, loading problems, and occasional performance instability. A game of this scale and budget should deliver a much more polished experience. Its reputation and hype should not excuse technical shortcomings. It is disappointing to see these issues overlooked in reviews that award it near-perfect scores. Ambition alone does not equal perfection.
